description: Versioned T11 calibration fixtures. Each scenario replays a 30-day calendar of learner evidence through the deterministic engine and policy. Days are offsets from the simulation start; the harness applies each event at 09:00 UTC on its day.

scenarios.name: new_concept
scenarios.description: A first exposure followed by a strong first retrieval, then spaced reviews. Gate scenario: first review must land inside the PRD 012 window.

scenarios.name: overdue
scenarios.description: A review missed by two weeks. Gate scenario: actual elapsed time drives retrievability but the new interval stays inside the policy cap.

scenarios.name: weak_prerequisite
scenarios.description: A dependent concept fails while its prerequisite is weak. Gate scenario: the lapse is flagged weak_prerequisite_recover and the next review is pulled earlier for Recover work.

scenarios.name: comeback
scenarios.description: A three-week absence then a successful retrieval. Gate scenario: progress is preserved, elapsed time is used, and the next review is capped to a welcoming interval.
